note: 0.1.3 hook speed (lib/transcript.pm temp_paths): a sweep with no paths.jsonl takes its temp paths from the transcript's last 5 MB. A 120,000-character word with no delimiter in it (an image's base64, a minified blob) is read in linear time, and the paths after it are still found, each once, in order. One pattern over the whole tail tried the tasks/*.output form from every position of such a word to its end: quadratic, 33 s for 100,000 characters, about 86 s on a real 41 MB transcript's tail, past the checkpoint's 10 s and every hook's timeout (the sweep runs in PostCompact and in Stop's reconcile too)
